title: Ukrainian drone attack sets fire to oil tanker carrying 23 Indians off Russia
description: The Aframax Rio tanker caught fire off the Russian coast after an attack by unmanned vessels. All 23 crew members onboard, who were Indian nationals, were successfully rescued by emergency crews. The incident occurred near Sochi, leading to the closure of beaches in the area. Authorities monitored air and water quality, assuring safety for public health.

title: Amid Canada trade talks, NSAs discuss security coop
description: India and Canada are engaged in a security dialogue to strengthen their bilateral relations. NSA Ajit Doval hosted his Canadian counterpart David Morrison for discussions on security issues. Both nations reviewed their progress in law enforcement cooperation and identified areas for further collaboration. Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand is also scheduled to visit India later this month.

title: Man deposits Rs 85.3 lakh given to him as cash gifts, gets notice; ITAT gives relief
description: In one such case in Chennai, a man received cash gifts of Rs 85.03 lakh from his relatives. The Income Tax Department began making enquiries into the source of the Rs 85.03 lakh deposited by the man. The department also sent tax notices to the relatives who had given him the cash.  The man eventually won relief in ITAT Chennai.

title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Incident left Capt Machchhar with 'depressed skull fracture'
description: Captain Smit Machchhar faced serious injuries from his co-pilot during the flight's crisis situation. The co-pilot attacked him with an axe, resulting in a skull fracture that required emergency surgery. Doctors monitored his recovery closely and assisted him for further treatment in the UAE. The Indian embassy is providing support to Captain Machchhar and his family during this challenging time.

title: Chang’e-6 moon soil reveals metallic iron never seen before in lunar samples
description: Recent analysis of lunar soil samples returned by China's Chang’e-6 mission revealed a unique form of iron. This iron, γ-Fe, exhibits exceptional magnetic properties, which could provide insights into the Moon's ancient magnetic field. Researchers suggest that extreme impacts on the lunar surface caused the formation and preservation of this unusual iron. The findings could enhance our understanding of the Moon's geological history and its evolution over time.

title: Punjab govt moves SC against CBI probe into ‘bribe syndicate’ linked to Mann OSD
description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's government has approached the Supreme Court for an urgent hearing. They aim to challenge a High Court order that mandated a CBI investigation into corruption allegations. The High Court's concerns include alleged coercive actions by the Central Bureau of Investigation in the state. The Punjab government argues that the orders violate governance principles outlined in the Constitution.

title: Yemeni government fighters recorded driving vehicles over Houthi opponents
description: The videos gave a glimpse into the brutal closing stages of a pitched battle for control ​of territory near the strait that the Houthis had captured last month

title: ED unearths bribe racket involving top executives of 40 PSUs, banks & companies
description: Enforcement Directorate has uncovered a bribery racket involving executives from at least 40 public sector undertakings and banks. This scheme involved laundering corporate social responsibility funds through multiple trusts operated by a fake doctor. The fake doctor has been impersonating a medical professional for nearly three decades while receiving substantial donations. Investigations revealed kickbacks were paid, with funds returned to donors after deducting commissions.

title: Rajnath launches first desi fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched ‘Surya’, India’s first indigenously-built fleet support ship in Visakhapatnam. He also laid the keel for the fifth ship in the series and inaugurated upgraded infrastructure at Hindustan Shipyard Limited. These developments aim to enhance the Indian Navy’s operational capabilities and self-reliance in naval shipbuilding. Additionally, Rajnath announced the establishment of a second production line for Shakti engines in Koraput.

title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy says intelligence shows Russia is preparing massive attack

title: Election Commission: Was ready to meet 240 oppn MPs but not at their chosen venue
description: Election Commission declined a meeting with opposition MPs led by Rahul Gandhi at Parliament House annexe. The commission emphasized meetings should occur on its premises and through authorized representatives. Despite being offered a chance to submit a memorandum, the MPs rejected this proposal. The Commission stated it had not received prior appointment requests from the parties until late in the day.

title: Cabinet adopts resolution hailing achievements of PM Modi
description: Cabinet has adopted a resolution recognizing Narendra Modi's 25 years of public service as Chief Minister and Prime Minister. This resolution highlights various policies that benefited the common man, showcasing Modi's governance style. It mentions key initiatives like SWAGAT and PRAGATI that improved governance and service delivery. Additionally, it discusses welfare schemes that helped millions escape poverty and empowered women in society.

The police stopped their march just before reaching Akashvani Bhavan, leading to a lengthy dharna by the MPs. Despite police attempts to remove the protesters, several MPs entered the Akashvani premises and continued their demonstration. Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and accused his government of treasonous actions against the country.

The investigation stems from a High Court order based on allegations from the Enforcement Directorate. Various individuals are named in the FIR for their alleged involvement in corruption and manipulation of government processes. Mann criticized the timing of the raids as politically motivated amid upcoming elections.

description: Lord Rami Ranger has successfully challenged the decision to revoke his CBE by King Charles. The revocation was based on allegations of breaching the parliamentary code of conduct. Justice Nathalie Lieven ruled that the decision could be subject to judicial review due to its significant personal consequences. Lord Ranger's legal team argues that due process was not followed in the decision-making process.

Astronomers find ‘phoenix planet’ born from ashes of a dying star
description: A team of astronomers has discovered a second-generation planet orbiting a white dwarf named HS 0209+0832. This planet formed from the material that the white dwarf expelled during its death. The atmosphere of the white dwarf contains heavy elements such as zinc, copper, and niobium. This discovery could change the way astronomers search for similar planets around dead stars.

title: Maryland dairy farm spill kills nearly 11,000 fish across 25 species
description: A tragic incident has unfolded at Basin Run, where nearly 11,000 fish have succumbed to the consequences of a manure lagoon overflow from Kilby Farms. The Maryland Department of the Environment has traced the source of this discharge back to a series of ongoing pollution violations. Local residents, frustrated with the recurring environmental harm, are demanding accountability.

title: Jammu and Kashmir: Arms & drugs seized in cross-border smuggling case; 4 held
description: J&K Police arrested four suspects linked to cross-border drug and arms smuggling. The police seized a Beretta pistol, magazines, live rounds, and narcotics during this operation. Initial arrests occurred when two men were stopped at a checkpoint and found with heroin and a firearm. This investigation revealed connections with handlers based in Pakistan and previous air-dropped consignments. The case has been registered under relevant laws with further investigation ongoing.

These experiences, including shark tagging and plankton exploration, aim to ignite students' passion for marine science, fostering a connection between youth and the ocean.

This pivotal moment allows Palestinians the chance to choose their leaders following a prolonged hiatus. However, logistical hurdles, largely due to restrictions imposed by Israel in occupied regions, pose significant challenges.

This remarkable innings paved the way for India's eight-wicket triumph over West Indies. Debutant Naman Dhir made a mark too, claiming three wickets as the Windies were limited to 171 runs. India now leads the series 1-0, showcasing their prowess in both batting and bowling.

description: India ended their three-match home friendly window with a 1-6 defeat to Uruguay at Salt Lake Stadium on Tuesday. Anirudh Thapa's goal briefly gave the home faithfuls something to celebrate. But in a game of two halves, Uruguay found their scoring shoes with Darwin Nunez, Maxi Araujo, Rodrigo Zalazar, Juan Manuel Sanabria and Rodrigo Aguirre hitting the back of the net.

title: Paramount closes $110bn deal with Warner Bros Discovery: The new firm is Skydance
Mandhana era begins: Shafali Verma, Deepti Sharma named India vice-captains
description: Shafali Verma and Deepti Sharma have been appointed as vice-captains for the T20I and ODI teams. This leadership change follows Harmanpreet Kaur's resignation as captain, while she continues as a player. Smriti Mandhana has been appointed full-time captain and will lead the team in upcoming series. The new leadership group will face Zimbabwe in a three-match T20I series and three ODIs.

title: Trump says Iran taking out LA and San Diego would be 'small price to pay'
Lithuania ready to cover cost if US establishes military base
description: Lithuanian Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius has declared his willingness to finance the establishment of a permanent US military base in Lithuania. Since 2019, Lithuania has been hosting a rotating US battalion and is eager for a long-term military presence. Concurrently, the Lithuanian parliament is considering lifting constitutional prohibitions on nuclear weapons, a move that has drawn sharp criticism from Russia, citing heightened regional tensions.

title: FIR against BJP BLA over 'false' Form-7 applications, first in Telangana
description: An FIR has been lodged against BJP Booth Level Agent S Balachander for allegedly filing false voter deletion requests. The complaint, initiated by an election official, triggered a police inquiry. Congress leaders claim these submissions aim to unjustly disenfranchise valid voters from the electoral list. In response, Telangana’s Chief Electoral Officer has ordered District Election Officers to take action against these fraudulent applications.

title: BCCI secretary Saikia explains why VVS Laxman attended selection meeting | Exclusive
description: VVS Laxman, the head of the BCCI Centre of Excellence, took part in an important senior selection meeting intended to enhance the dialogue between national selectors and the Centre. BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia specified that Laxman's aim was to ensure better communication about player fitness and availability, a crucial step as the team prepares for their imminent tour of New Zealand.

title: 'Making steady progress': Indian embassy in UAE updates on flydubai pilot Machchhar
Smriti Mandhana replaces Harmanpreet Kaur as India captain: ‘Very special honour’
description: Smriti Mandhana has been appointed as the new captain of the Indian women's cricket team. She takes over the leadership role from Harmanpreet Kaur, who announced her resignation as captain. Mandhana has led India in several T20Is and ODIs prior to this appointment. The Board of Control for Cricket in India expressed confidence in her leadership abilities. Harmanpreet will remain part of the squad as a player during this transition.

title: Humiliation, torn clothes and badges: Delhi women cops allege assault at protest sites
description: A senior Delhi Police officer addressed the treatment of women police personnel during ongoing protests. She highlighted incidents of misbehaviour and assault faced by these personnel while on duty. Videos circulating online show the challenges that women police officers encounter at protest sites.

SpaceX overpumped 128M gallons of groundwater; now Texas city has to pay $175,000
description: McGregor has agreed to pay $175,000 in penalties for groundwater overuse linked to SpaceX's activities. The city will make a one-time payment and subsequent quarterly payments over 25 years. Residents have expressed concerns over the arrangement, as SpaceX primarily drove the overpumping issue. City officials are exploring alternative water sources to address future needs. Groundwater conservation efforts will focus on monitoring and reusing available water resources.

title: DRDO conducts maiden live jump of advanced high-altitude parachute in Ladakh
description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully executed its first live jump with the advanced high-altitude parachute system in Nyoma, from a height of 16,000 feet. This successful jump verified the parachute's effectiveness for mass drops, ensuring safety at high altitudes. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh commended this milestone as a testament to Aatmanirbhar Bharat, showcasing the synergy of India's defence entities.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $20m; 5 years later, Denver has 4 new childcare centres
Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation: Why are his parents stepping in?
description: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation has not posted since January 2026. They continue their charitable work through Operation Breakthrough’s Ignition Lab. Donna Kelce met with Ignition Lab students during a Kansas City Chiefs game. Ed Kelce visited first graders at Operation Breakthrough. Travis Kelce’s foundation got its first post after January on Travis’ birthday.

title: 'Dhappa': Cops tried to stop INDIA bloc march to EC; Rahul pulled a surprise
description: Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra gave the INDIA bloc protest against the Election Commission an unexpected second act after police tried to stop INDIA bloc march against Gyanesh Kumar and began detaining opposition MPs.

title: Why Dybala and Molina are blocked from Messi’s farewell despite 2022 squad invite
description: Paulo Dybala and Nahuel Molina will miss Lionel Messi’s Argentina farewell after Roma blocked their trip to Buenos Aires. The club cited the lengthy journey and proximity of important fixtures, with manager Gian Piero Gasperini stressing the demanding schedule. Both players remain linked to Argentina’s 2022 World Cup triumph, but neither was selected for the current international window.

title: Delaware homeowner wins court order in dispute over HOA records, maintenance
description: In a noteworthy court case, Gwendolyn Colston took on her community developer without legal representation and secured a favorable ruling. The Delaware Court of Chancery instructed the developer to ensure the upkeep of ponds and drainage systems in the area. Additionally, Colston gained access to insights on a contentious $44,329.

title: Travis and Jason Kelce’s $10,000 donation: How did it help Laila Edwards’ family?
description: Earlier this year, Travis and Jason Kelce quietly donated $10,000 to help a Team USA hockey star’s family travel to Milan for the 2026 Winter Olympics. The contribution supported a $50,000 fundraiser created after the family struggled to afford the trip. Travis also offered encouragement before the Olympic debut, while Jason and Kylie attended the gold-medal game. Team USA eventually defeated Canada 2-1 in overtime for gold.

title: Garba’s new luxury flex: Valet, VVIP seats and butlers
description: During this year's Navratri, vadodara's garba events have embraced luxury, offering participants premium packages that promise comfort and exclusivity. Attendees can enjoy benefits like valet parking, VIP seating, and personalized services to enhance their experience. Special packages are also available for non-resident Indians and out-of-state guests seeking convenience. Meanwhile, Ahmedabad is stepping up with high-priced options, indicating a broader shift toward exquisite and lavish festival celebrations.
